title: The probe paths sit on the project's auth-exempt list scoped exactly to the resolved set on the resolved listener
asA: operator running the service behind an auth middleware that rejects unauthenticated requests by default
iWant: the supervisor's probe requests to bypass auth on exactly the profile-resolved probe paths and only on the listener the profile bound those handlers to
soThat: the supervisor gets the answer without a credential it cannot present and no adjacent route falls under the same exemption

acceptanceCriteria.description: On the Kubernetes profile with fused topology and an auth middleware that rejects unauthenticated requests, GET on the resolved `/live` and `/ready` paths returns the probe status; GET on any other user-traffic route returns the middleware's unauthenticated response.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process on the Kubernetes profile with fused topology, a project auth middleware installed on the user-traffic listener that returns 401 on unauthenticated requests, and a user-authored `/api/orders` route on that listener
acceptanceCriteria.when: unauthenticated GET requests are issued to `/live`, `/ready`, `/api/orders`, and `/ready/next`
acceptanceCriteria.then: `/live` and `/ready` return 200 or 503 per the probe answer; `/api/orders` returns 401; `/ready/next` returns the route's normal handler-or-not-found response after the middleware runs (a match on `/ready/next` is not treated as an exempt path)

acceptanceCriteria.description: On the Kubernetes profile with separate-port topology, the separate probe listener does not install the project auth middleware and answers probes without an auth challenge; the user-traffic listener answers `/live` and `/ready` under normal auth rules.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process on the Kubernetes profile with `probeListener.separatePort: 9091` and a project auth middleware installed on the user-traffic listener
acceptanceCriteria.when: unauthenticated GET requests are issued to `/live` and `/ready` on both port 9091 and on the user-traffic port
acceptanceCriteria.then: the port-9091 requests return the probe status; the user-traffic-port requests return the auth middleware's unauthenticated response

acceptanceCriteria.description: The exemption list produced by the profile at boot enumerates exactly the resolved probe path set, scoped by exact-match rules, and is refused if any entry contains a wildcard or prefix syntax.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the exemption list produced by the profile resolver on the Kubernetes profile default
acceptanceCriteria.when: the exemption-list emitter runs and the produced entries are inspected
acceptanceCriteria.then: the list contains exactly the strings `/live` and `/ready` and their exact-match matcher rule; any injected entry containing `*` or a trailing slash to imply a prefix causes the emitter to refuse with a stable-coded error
